corrections.change: Individual survival is distinct from reproductive continuity.
Prepared amylase replaces shared oral material. A negative iodine test is not proof of no starch or proof of sugar; test limits and controls explicit.
Bile disperses rather than chemically digests fats; absorbed fats largely enter lymph; much water absorbed before large intestine.
Current health guidance replaces blanket claims, with cultural accounts distinguished from treatment evidence.
Volume and pressure cause airflow. Quiet expiration uses recoil; model cannot show rib motion or actual diaphragm contraction.
No mouth suction/blowing through alkaline reagent. Both air samples contain carbon dioxide; matched gas volumes and early clouding are essential.
Breathing, gas exchange and cellular aerobic respiration are distinct; energy is released from food.
Frog skin works on land and in water; development is not evolution; altitude changes oxygen pressure more than its atmospheric percentage.

additions.reason: Separates evidence for starch from a claim about sugar and identifies dilution as a confounder.
Makes the pressure mechanism and limitations of a lung model explicit.
Integrates nutrient and gas transport without conflating organs or mechanisms.
